criteria.title: Requested package formats are first-class domain and schema values
criteria.assertion: The core domain and migration explicitly support npm, pypi, conan, deb, rpm, pub, go_modules, and gradle formats without collapsing them to a generic placeholder.
criteria.expected_result: Format enums and CHECK constraints preserve the requested values; unsupported formats are rejected by domain helpers or schema constraints.

criteria.title: Package backend registration is config-driven and uses secret references
criteria.assertion: Package control-plane config can register nexus, pulp, and filesystem_mock backend refs and validates required backend fields while exposing secret references, not inline password/token fields.
criteria.expected_result: Enabled package config requires at least one valid backend; HTTP backends require a base URL; filesystem_mock requires root_dir; secret material is represented by auth_secret_ref, tls_secret_ref, or secret_refs.

criteria.title: Package projection repository stores repositories, artifacts, and publication/promotion state
criteria.assertion: The repository interface, PG implementation, and migration cover package repositories, artifacts, and publication/promotion projections.
criteria.expected_result: Repository methods and tables exist for repository, artifact, and publication projections, including policy decision and promotion status fields.

criteria.title: Nostr-derived idempotency/projection cache exists without making DB the source of truth
criteria.assertion: Durable package intent rows are keyed by request_event_id and projection rows carry last_event_created_at/last_event_id ordering metadata, with docs/comments identifying DB as projection/cache only.
criteria.expected_result: Duplicate request event IDs upsert one cached intent; stale projection writes are suppressed by event ordering predicates.

criteria.title: No reactor, MCP, CLI, backend adapter, or REST CRUD behavior is introduced in Item 1
criteria.assertion: This phase adds only foundation scaffolding and does not introduce package mutation handlers, tools, commands, adapters, or REST CRUD endpoints.
criteria.expected_result: No package REST routes or command/tool handlers are added; later items must implement Nostr-first mutation behavior.

coverage_notes: This acceptance set intentionally covers Item 1 only. Later feature phases must add Nostr reactor/MCP/CLI/backend acceptance criteria before the full capability can be marked complete.
